keepers.cost_rule: Keeper costs 2 rounds earlier than the round in which the player was drafted the prior season (e.g. drafted round 8 -> kept at a round 6 cost).
keepers.eligibility: Player must have been drafted the prior season. Players added via waiver/free agency (undrafted) cannot be kept.

keepers.cost_rule: Keeper costs 3 rounds earlier than the round in which the player was drafted the prior season (e.g. drafted round 8 -> kept at a round 5 cost).
keepers.eligibility: Player must have been drafted the prior season, OR be an undrafted free agent (UDFA) kept under the 2026 UDFA rule below.

udfa_rule.note: NEW for 2026: a team may keep up to one UDFA (undrafted free agent / waiver pickup) at a 13th-round cost. Confirmed with Sean: this is one OF the two keeper slots, NOT a bonus third -- the cap is still 2 keepers total.

keepers._note: Keeper count 2 total, confirmed. UDFA counts against that 2.

rules._manager_rename_note: Greene transferred his team to Milligan for 2026. convert_bigboard.py applies these renames to the Miami Team sheet, so the workbook doesn't have to be edited.

rules._format_note: Zimmer switched from auction to snake for 2026. The auction cockpit is fully preserved -- set format back to 'auction' here and it reactivates, no code change needed.
rules._teams_note: Derived from 2025 ESPN draft history team names -- ESPN teams get renamed between seasons, so verify/update before the real draft. slot=null until the snake draft order is drawn.
rules._roster_note: 2026: 9 starters (QB/RB/RB/WR/WR/TE/FLEX/FLEX/DEF) + 7 bench = 16 drafted. Changes from auction era: 2 WR (was 3), kicker removed, 2nd FLEX added. Plus 1 IR slot, tracked in irSlots -- excluded from rosterSlots because it isn't draftable.
